title: Initials Story · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Initials Story · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose three letters in a fixed order. The lead makes a sensible three-word phrase whose words begin with those letters in order. The phrase follows the initial letters and can be understood. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Initials Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The phrase follows the initial letters and can be understood.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The phrase follows the initial letters and can be understood.
